identity.tagline: BUILT FOR THE OCEAN. ENGINEERED FOR IMPACT.
identity.visionStatement: To develop an intelligent and reliable underwater robotic platform capable of supporting underwater exploration, inspection, surveying, and object-retrieval operations.
identity.description: An advanced underwater robotic platform developed by Team Triton, integrating precision propulsion, embedded control, intelligent perception, and mission-oriented autonomy for underwater inspection, surveying, and object-retrieval operations.

specifications.horizontalConfiguration: 4 horizontal vectored thrusters mounted at 45° corner angles
specifications.verticalConfiguration: 4 vertical fixed thrusters with 182.60 mm longitudinal spacing
specifications.dimensionDiscrepancyNote: The project poster lists dimensions as 482.6 × 331 × 262 mm, which defines the main structural chassis envelope. The engineering CAD drawing details a 582.70 mm outer dimension, which represents the total diagonal envelope spanning across the outermost angled corner thruster assemblies. This distinction is flagged for engineering confirmation and clarity.

horizontal.name: Sway
horizontal.thrusters: 4 vectored corner thrusters in differential opposing pairs

horizontal.name: Yaw
horizontal.motion: Heading rotation around vertical Z axis
horizontal.thrusters: 4 vectored corner thrusters in rotational torque pair

vertical.name: Roll
vertical.motion: Port and starboard angular tilt stabilization
vertical.thrusters: Left vs right vertical thrusters running differentially

vertical.name: Pitch
vertical.motion: Fore and aft trim incline stabilization
vertical.thrusters: Front vs rear vertical thrusters running differentially

power.pdb: Power Distribution Board with heavy-duty copper busbars
power.conversion: UBEC / DC-DC Buck Conversion (5V & 12V Regulated Rails)
protection: Hardware Magnetic Kill Switch for instantaneous manual shutdown
Low Battery Voltage Protection & Return Failsafe
Passive Positive Buoyancy for guaranteed surface retrieval
Hydrodynamic Thruster Guards preventing debris snagging

hull.sealing: Precision radial and face O-ring seals
hull.penetrators: Waterproof marine cable penetrators with potted epoxy
hull.endCap: Removable CNC aluminum / Delrin end cap with circular bolt pattern

control.stabilisation: Real-time EKF sensor fusion and PID closed-loop attitude stabilization
control.allocation: 6-DOF Thruster Allocation Matrix with individual PWM ESC command output

sensors.name: IMU
sensors.function: 9-Axis inertial measurement unit combining 3-axis accelerometer, 3-axis gyroscope, and internal compass for attitude and angular velocity estimation.

sensors.name: Depth Sensor
sensors.function: High-resolution piezoresistive pressure sensor providing millimeter-level depth measurement and water temperature telemetry.

sensors.name: Magnetometer
sensors.function: High-precision geomagnetic compass sensor immune to drift, providing accurate magnetic heading reference.

sensors.name: Leak Sensor
sensors.function: Internal moisture probe placed at the lowest point of the pressure hull, instantly triggering surfacing sequence upon water ingress.

sensors.name: Temperature Sensor
sensors.function: Monitors internal electronics enclosure ambient temperature to protect compute and power components.

sensors.name: Front Camera
sensors.function: Forward-facing visual inspection camera providing real-time feed for YOLOv11 target detection and gate transit.

sensors.name: Downward Camera
sensors.function: Downward-angled camera for seafloor tracking, pipeline following, bathymetric surveying, and seabed marker identification.

sensors.name: Three-Hydrophone Array
sensors.function: Triangular acoustic hydrophone array calculating Time Difference of Arrival (TDoA) to locate submerged acoustic pingers.

ai.updateNote: Upgraded to YOLOv11 deep neural network object detection from previous YOLOv8 Nano architecture.
preprocessing: OpenCV frame capture and RGB normalization
CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) for turbid water contrast enhancement
Dynamic White Balance correction to compensate for underwater red-wavelength light attenuation
Resolution optimization for high-throughput edge inference
ai.demoDisclaimer: Object detection demonstrations in this application utilize Robosub benchmark footage, pool qualification recordings, and visual simulations. Real model weights are benchmarked for competition gate transit.

operatingModes.title: INSPECTION
operatingModes.description: Inspection of ships, structures, pipelines, and marine assets with high-resolution visual and depth telemetry.

operatingModes.title: SURVEY
operatingModes.description: Large-area mapping, underwater inspection surveys, and environmental data collection across GPS-denied aquatic zones.

operatingModes.title: MINING / OBJECT RETRIEVAL
operatingModes.description: Locate, identify, grasp, and collect underwater objects, scientific samples, and submerged equipment.

capabilities.name: Gate Transit
capabilities.desc: Autonomous detection, trajectory planning, and alignment through underwater qualification gates.

capabilities.name: Waypoint Navigation
capabilities.desc: Dead reckoning navigation combining IMU, depth, and compass for accurate 3D waypoint execution.

capabilities.name: Object Detection
capabilities.desc: Real-time edge classification of underwater markers, gates, buoys, and simulated debris.

capabilities.name: Acoustic Localisation
capabilities.desc: Acoustic pinger triangulation via TDoA to home in on underwater target transmitters.

capabilities.name: Task Execution
capabilities.desc: Mission decision state machine executing sequential inspection and station-keeping protocols.

capabilities.name: Return to Start
capabilities.desc: Reverse path retracing and emergency positive-buoyancy surfacing upon timeout or critical voltage.

sponsorship.heading: ENGINEER THE FUTURE BENEATH THE SURFACE.
sponsorship.supportingMessage: Partner with Team Triton to support the development of intelligent underwater robotics and contribute to the next generation of marine engineering innovation.

categories.title: Hardware and Component Sponsorship
categories.desc: Contribution of brushless underwater thrusters, 30A ESCs, high-discharge 3S LiPo battery packs, waterproof penetrators, and O-ring sealing hardware.

categories.title: Financial Sponsorship
categories.desc: Direct monetary sponsorship to fund material procurement, water tank test facility rentals, specialized tooling, and competition entry logistics.

categories.title: Technology and Computing Support
categories.desc: Providing embedded AI compute boards (NVIDIA Jetson series), GPU training compute credits, development licenses, and underwater vision hardware.

categories.title: Manufacturing and Fabrication Support
categories.desc: Support for precision CNC milling of aluminum chassis plates, acrylic lathe turning for pressure hull tubes, waterjet cutting, and hard anodization.

categories.title: Research and Technical Collaboration
categories.desc: Joint engineering research, mentorship from senior marine roboticists, access to oceanographic testbeds, and academic collaboration programs.
